events.title: Aquarium of the Pacific
events.blurb: Sea lions, sharks, jellies and a lorikeet aviary on Rainbow Harbor. Open 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily; adults $49.95, kids 3–11 $34.95.
events.blurbEs: Leones marinos, tiburones, medusas y un aviario de loris junto a Rainbow Harbor. Abre de 9 a.m. a 6 p.m. todos los días; adultos $49.95, niños de 3 a 11 años $34.95.

events.title: Forever Tour: Barbara Mason & War
events.addr: 300 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90802
events.blurb: The Forever Tour brings soul singer Barbara Mason and funk band War, which formed in Long Beach, to the arena on Saturday night.
events.blurbEs: El Forever Tour trae a la cantante de soul Barbara Mason y a la banda de funk War, formada en Long Beach, a la arena el sábado por la noche.

events.title: Shoreline Village & Rainbow Harbor
events.addr: 419 Shoreline Village Dr, Long Beach, CA 90802
events.blurb: The waterfront promenade with harbor views, the lighthouse and the Queen Mary across the bay.
events.blurbEs: El paseo junto al puerto con el faro y el Queen Mary al otro lado de la bahía.
